about.name: hi, i'm luana
about.bio1: I've been a full-stack dev for about 3 years. I've worked with many technologies, but currently I work with Go on the backend and React/TypeScript on the frontend. Along with microservices, Kafka, MongoDB, gRPC - the whole stack.
about.bio2: This blog is my little corner to document what I learn, the bugs that knock me down, cost me sleep (and help me grow), and the solutions that finally make sense. I write for myself, but I'm happy if it helps someone along the way. Each post has a feedback button: if something doesn't make sense, if there's an error, or if you want to share a similar experience, let me know! I love learning from other people.
about.bio3: Outside of work: my love, cocktails, my cat, 8 ball pool and a lot of questionable music.
